description: This PHP file defines the SandboxNode class within the Twig templating engine. The class filters part of the Twig syntax tree to represent a sandboxed execution block, managing sandbox enabling and disabling during template rendering.

classes.name: SandboxNode
classes.description: Represents a sandbox node in the Twig templating system, managing sandbox activation and deactivation during template rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a SandboxNode with a given body node and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to implement sandbox activation, execution of the body node, and sandbox deactivation during template rendering.
